claim.claim-text: 1. A cartridge for an aerosol provision system comprising the cartridge and a control unit, wherein the system comprises a vaporiser for vaporising an aerosolisable material, wherein the cartridge comprises:
2. A cartridge according to claim 1, wherein the contoured surface comprises a plurality of grooves.
3. A cartridge according to any preceding claim, wherein the contoured surface comprises a plurality of projections and/or recesses.

4. A cartridge according to preceding claim, wherein the cartridge comprises a first surface, a second surface, and a first side surface and a second side surface, wherein the side surfaces are located between the first surface and the second surface.
5. A cartridge according to claim 4, wherein the contoured surface is located on at least one of the side surfaces; the first surface; and/or the second surface.
6. A cartridge according to claim 4 or 5, wherein the side surfaces are inclined towards the outlet.
7. A cartridge according to any preceding claim, wherein the contoured surface is located proximal the outlet.
8. A cartridge according to any preceding claim, wherein the contoured surface extends from a first end of the reservoir to a second end, opposite the first end, of the reservoir.
9. A cartridge according to any preceding claim, wherein the contoured surface extends around the entirety of a circumference of the reservoir.
10. A cartridge according to any preceding claim, wherein the reservoir is made of plastic.
11. A cartridge according to any preceding claim, wherein the reservoir extends around the aerosol outlet tube.
12. A cartridge according to any preceding claim, wherein the reservoir is annular.
13. A cartridge according to any preceding claim, wherein the reservoir comprises a first end which is proximal the outlet of the cartridge, and a second end which is proximal the vaporiser.
14. A cartridge according to any preceding claim, wherein the reservoir contains the aerosolisable material for aerosolising.
15. A cartridge according to any preceding claim, wherein the vaporiser is located in the cartridge.

16. An aerosol provision system comprising the cartridge of any preceding claim and a control unit, wherein the control unit comprises a cartridge receiving section that includes an interface arranged to cooperatively engage with the cartridge so as to releasably couple the cartridge to the control unit, wherein the control unit further comprises a power supply and control circuitry.

17. An aerosol provision system according to claim 16, wherein the control circuitry is configured to selective supply power from the power supply to the vaporiser located in the cartridge via their cooperatively engaging interfaces.
